## Summary

Describe the problem, the change, and any public API or CLI impact.

## Validation

List the exact checks performed and any failures or unavailable prerequisites.

- [ ] `make check` passes, or limitations are explained.
- [ ] New behavior has synthetic tests; no live model calls are required.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private traces, or generated corpora are included.
- [ ] Frozen protocol and artifact identities have not been silently changed.
